title: Integrative analysis identifies DCBLD2 and immune-related biomarkers for major depressive disorder: evidence from human peripheral blood, post-mortem brain, and rat models.
summary: Integrated human blood, post-mortem brain and rat-model analyses identified DCBLD2 and immune-associated biomarkers for major depressive disorder; associations are bounded by the experimental and observational evidence.
ai_technology: Machine-learning analysis applies the stated model to the paper’s medicine dataset and evaluates the reported outcome.
